publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.5.5 lets you create a scheduled-job (heartbeat) monitor in the console: choose Scheduled job under What to check, set the expected interval and grace, and the monitor page shows a check-in URL once with a copy-ready curl line (a private runner must be running; Create or replace check-in URL issues another and retires the old one). It also makes pasting many URLs or a CSV tell you what it understood: URLs one per line and a CSV with a url header are told apart automatically, columns may come in any order, and the import page now lists the supported files (Uptime monitor JSON, UptimeRobot v3 JSON and event-log CSV, Pingdom check details, Better Stack pages, Site24x7 monitor list) with export steps and samples. A monitor CSV exported from UptimeRobot is still not read; the page says so. A sensitive action that needs a second factor now opens a Verify to continue dialog that takes an authenticator code, a recovery code or a passkey, or lets you add your first authenticator (QR code, app link or manual secret) or passkey on the spot, saves your recovery codes, and then finishes your action without retyping. The run-locally guide shows the one required PATH step beside the first rer dev. The pinned @runeditrun/rer is now 0.2.108, and authenticator setup adds one small QR code library to the checkout; update an existing checkout with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile. No new migration and no new required settings. Known issues: restoring an installation archive does not bring back the list of erased people, so a Business that pairs again after a restore and still lists an erased person could invite them again; a company that has signed an agent policy but never sent company settings is treated as running, so its feed answers with an empty page (no token or decision is shared); a response body over 64 KiB still fails the check, so monitor a smaller page such as a health endpoint. The product screenshot was taken on 0.4.0, before the console changes of 0.5.0, 0.5.1, 0.5.2, 0.5.3, 0.5.4 and 0.5.5. Product screenshot: .github/assets/release/uptime-0.4.0-monitor-1440.png
